### Bio:

I earned my bachelor’s degree in Mathematics from Warren Wilson College, with a minor in Data Science. I later studied Environmental Engineering in a PhD program at the University of Regina in Canada, but eventually realized that I wanted to pursue a field more closely aligned with my interests in mathematics, statistics, and data analysis. I am especially interested in quantitative methods and their applications in health-related fields. Outside of school, I really enjoy traveling, exploring new places, and experiencing different cultures.
